lens: Recheck R-001: auth-copy cleanup and claim accuracy

counterweight_triage.concern: R-001: setup failure during a partial auth copy could leave the file behind.
counterweight_triage.disposition: Environment setup and review execution are both inside the try/finally. The added test raises after writing part of the copy, verifies the review did not run, and confirms the copy was removed.

next_move: Accept R-001 as closed. The release notes and executor documentation say the copy is deleted when the preflight ends; that matches the cleanup path and the covered review-failure and partial-copy-failure cases.
non_claims: This review assessed the supplied semantic payload and did not execute tests.
Cleanup depends on the unlink succeeding; the payload does not establish behavior if deletion itself fails or the process is terminated outside normal Python cleanup.
